categories.name: It works
categories.notes: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors; the 10 warnings are the scaffold's ImageSharp NU190x advisories, so 5. Everything else scores 0. GET / returns 404 'No template exists to render the document at URL /', because the scaffold's WWW siteRoot is the only document. There is no front page, no posts, no imported media and no domain. The model never got past creating the schema.

categories.name: Content modeling
categories.notes: Folders/kinds 4/8: the types that exist are filed correctly (heroBlock, textBlock, imageBlock and quoteBlock as elements in Blocks; blogFrontPage and blogPost as documents in Pages), but the model is far from complete. Block grid 1/7: the block set is sensible (rich text, image, quote, hero) and a 'Blog Block Grid' data type was created in Custom/, but no blocks are configured in it and no page type uses it. Structure 1/5: aliases are camelCase and the data type is in /Custom/, but there are no allowed children (siteRoot → front page → posts), and the templates were created but never assigned to the doc types. Hygiene 1/5: no compositions are misused, but blogFrontPage and blogPost have no properties at all (no date, excerpt or listing image), and the empty block grid data type is orphaned.

categories.name: Code architecture & conventions
categories.notes: No Razor was written. The only view files are the empty stubs Umbraco generated for blogFrontPage.cshtml and blogPost.cshtml when the templates were created via MCP. There is no GetBlockGridHtmlAsync, no adapters, no ViewComponents and no view models. Conventions 1/5: Program.cs and appsettings.json are untouched and there are no migrations, but only because nothing was written. There is no styling or frontend build.

categories.name: Content & presentation
categories.notes: There is no content at all: no posts and no media. The front page screenshot shows Umbraco's 'Page Not Found' error page, and there is no blog post to screenshot.

categories.name: Process & honesty
categories.notes: Channel 1/3: all schema writes went through the umbraco MCP server. The 2 'database' and 2 'Management API' shell calls the check flagged were a find/stat of the SQLite file and unauthenticated curl status probes, not shortcuts. There were some stray reads outside the project (listings of ~/.nuget/packages). The order of operations was not followed: after failing to configure the block grid data type, the model spent about 15 minutes polling a dotnet log with ever-longer sleep commands, until the benchmark guard stopped it after 47 identical calls. Final report 0/2: there is none, and finalReport holds the guard's API error.

summary: The benchmark loop guard aborted the run. Via MCP the model created four block element types, two empty page types, two templates and an unconfigured Block Grid data type, then got stuck in a sleep/poll loop. It created no content and wrote no Razor, and the front page returns 404.
strengths: The element and page types it created are in the right folders, are the right kind and have camelCase aliases
The block set is sensible: hero, text with rich text, image with caption, quote
Used only the MCP channel for schema; no migrations; Program.cs and appsettings.json untouched

issues.text: The run never completed: the benchmark guard stopped it after 47 identical 'sleep 300; tail …' Bash calls polling the dotnet run log (transcript.jsonl)
https://localhost:44317/ returns 404 'No template exists to render the document at URL /'; no blog front page or posts exist
The 'Blog Block Grid' data type (Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid) was created with no blocks and never added to blogFrontPage or blogPost
The blogFrontPage and blogPost doc types have no properties, no allowed children and no assigned templates (snapshot.json)
No Razor or C# was written: Views/blogFrontPage.cshtml and Views/blogPost.cshtml are Umbraco's empty generated stubs, and there are no adapters or ViewComponents
No media was imported from unsplash/, and the site root has no domain
There is no final report; finalReport holds the guard's error message
Stray reads outside the project folder (listings of ~/.nuget/packages) while looking for Umbraco internals
